lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Use a heavy NGW layer with a deliberately unchanged broken schema/config
Run sync and interrupt or fail the staged fill
Verify the old layer remains usable
repeat after the cooldown until two attempts are recorded
fix the server config and sync again
value.expected: Failed fill never removes the old layer; an unchanged fingerprint runs at most twice per 24 hours and the third attempt is suppressed; Project settings reports the stopped layer and reset permits a new attempt; a changed/fixed fingerprint can rebuild successfully.
